Licences for the libraries in this folder
=========================================

Exact copies of the files index-online.html loads from jsDelivr
(build-offline.py checks their fingerprints). opentype.js and Paper.js were
copied from VCTREDTR's vendor folder; pdf-lib and fontkit come from npm (the
same files jsDelivr serves). Used only to build the one-file edition,
index.html.
